# Results folder

**Status: generated by actual execution on 2026-11-15** (UTC timestamps in
`run_metadata.json`). All stock prices are **simulated** (geometric Brownian
motion); no market data are used. Commands are run from the project root.

## Which command generates each output

| File | Command |
|---|---|
| `example_option.json` | `python scripts/price_option.py --spot 100 --strike 100 --maturity 1 --rate 0.05 --volatility 0.20 --option-type call --output-json results/example_option.json` |
| `baseline_summary.csv`, `baseline_terminal_pnl.csv`, `sample_paths.csv`, `figures/baseline_hedging_pnl.png`, `figures/sample_stock_paths.png` | `python scripts/run_experiments.py --config configs/baseline.json` |
| `transaction_cost_summary.csv`, `transaction_cost_terminal_pnl.csv`, `figures/transaction_cost_hedging_pnl.png` | `python scripts/run_experiments.py --config configs/transaction_costs.json` |
| `run_metadata.json` | both experiment commands (each adds or replaces only its own scenario section) |
| `report.md`, `figures/option_prices.png`, `figures/option_delta.png`, `figures/hedging_rmse_comparison.png` | `python scripts/generate_report.py` (needs both experiments first) |
| `test_results.xml` | `python -m pytest -q --junitxml=results/test_results.xml`, then `python scripts/sanitize_test_xml.py` (removes hostname and absolute paths) |

## Units and columns

Monetary amounts are in the same currency units as the stock price, **per
option on one share**, terminal and **undiscounted**. Positive P&L = profit
for the hedged option seller.

`*_summary.csv` (one row per strategy):

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| scenario, strategy | scenario name; `daily` or `weekly` |
| rebalance_every_steps | 1 (daily) or 5 (weekly) |
| n_rebalance_dates | hedge-setting dates including t = 0 (252 daily, 51 weekly) |
| transaction_cost_rate | proportional cost on traded stock notional (0.0005 = 5 bp) |
| premium | Black–Scholes call price received at t = 0 |
| n_paths | number of simulated paths |
| mean_pnl, std_pnl | mean and sample standard deviation (ddof = 1) |
| rmse_pnl | sqrt(mean(P&L²)), relative to zero |
| p05_pnl, median_pnl, p95_pnl | percentiles, NumPy `linear` method |
| min_pnl, max_pnl | extremes |
| mean_transaction_cost | mean cumulative nominal transaction cost per path |

`*_terminal_pnl.csv` (one row per simulated path): `path_id`,
`daily_terminal_pnl`, `daily_transaction_cost`, `weekly_terminal_pnl`,
`weekly_transaction_cost`. Row *i* refers to the same simulated path in both
files.

`sample_paths.csv`: `step`, `time_years`, and `path_00` … `path_09` — the first
10 of the 10,000 simulated stock paths (the full path set is not saved).

`example_option.json`: inputs, price, raw and scaled Greeks, implied-volatility
round trip, unit descriptions.

`run_metadata.json`: per scenario — configuration, seed, command, runtime,
outputs, Python and dependency versions, UTC timestamp; plus numerical
conventions. No personal paths are recorded.

## Reproducibility

The simulation uses `numpy.random.default_rng(42)`. Re-running the commands
with the same package versions (see `../requirements-lock.txt`) should give the
same numbers; a different NumPy version or platform may change floating-point
results slightly. Timestamps and runtimes will differ.
